bank.label: Bank statement
bank.hint: Joins a long description that wraps onto a second line, drops the heading row that repeats on each page and starts at the table heading. All pages go into one sheet.

marks.label: Marksheet
marks.hint: Keeps every line above the table (school, class, exam) and puts all pages into one sheet. Roll numbers and marks become numbers.

invoice.label: Invoice
invoice.hint: Keeps the lines above the table (seller, invoice number) and the totals below it. Quantities and amounts become numbers.

pages.label: One sheet per page
pages.hint: Keeps each page of the PDF on its own sheet, with nothing removed.
